name: Milligan University
academic_ranking: Private Christian liberal arts university founded 1866, affiliated with the Restoration Movement. Ranked #15 of 90 Regional Universities (South) by U.S. News & World Report and #214 of 604 by Washington Monthly (Master's Universities). Offers over 100 programs of study; student-to-faculty ratio approximately 10:1.

Prospective athletes should confirm merit/need-based aid and athletic scholarship packages with the admissions and financial aid offices.
facilities_notes: Milligan competes as the Buffaloes. Campus is a suburban 355-acre site in Elizabethton, TN. Specific softball facility details not confirmed from a live source during research (2026-07).
program_reputation: NAIA program competing in the Appalachian Athletic Conference (AAC). Athletics branded 'milliganbuffs.com'. Detailed competitive history/recent results not captured from a live source during this research pass.
